def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    top = grid[0]
    color = next((v for v in top if v != 0), None)
    if color is None:
        return out
    bottom = grid[-1]
    columns = [c for c, v in enumerate(top) if v == color and bottom[c] == color]
    divider = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid[1:], 1) if row and all(v == 2 for v in row)), len(grid))
    for c in columns:
        for r in range(1, divider):
            if grid[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = min(color + 1, 9)
    return out
PY
